name: Megalox Beta
description: Megalox Beta was a planet in the Expansion Region that housed a prison known as Megalox, which Poe Dameron and Black Squadron visited during their search for Lor San Tekka. The planet had a high gravity and was considered inhospitable, except for a small gravity field-covered zone that housed the Megalox prison. The planet was the site of a brief skirmish between the Resistance and the First Order.
